title: Audit past capital raises
summary: For a firm that has taken investor money: check each offering's exemption, filings, investor records and payments against the rules it relied on. It ends with a list of what to fix and a calendar of what is due.
outlineSteps: List each offering and the exemption it relied on
Confirm Form D was filed on time for each offering
Confirm state notice filings where investors bought
Check yearly Form D amendments for offerings still open
Check bad-actor questionnaires for covered persons
Check accreditation records for each investor
Check how investors were solicited against the exemption used
Reconcile the investor register to subscriptions and funds received
Check who was paid for raising capital
